approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
first_installment_sketch: The @graph fixture (directive sec 22): RED (fixture fails before recursive processing) -> PATCH (recursive processing) -> GREEN (fixture passes after). All fields real and cited from the directive and the repo; the second installment is the mobile overflow case (measured overflow -> root cause -> one-class correction -> viewport matrix green).
inputs: a test that genuinely failed before a fix
name: RED TEST -> GREEN TEST
outputs: an accumulating proof that fixes are proven, not asserted
purpose: Make every engineering post contain RED TEST -> PATCH -> GREEN TEST so readers learn something shareable.
template: Three blocks in order: RED TEST (the failing test, the failure output, the commit where it failed) / PATCH (the minimal change, nothing more) / GREEN TEST (the same test passing, the commit, the environment). Real examples from the directive to work through in order: @graph fixture failed before recursive processing, passes after; mobile measured overflow, root cause, one-class correction, viewport matrix green; reconciler 17 repeated gaps -> lifecycle semantics -> 15 legitimately suppressed -> 2 genuine work items -> second run idempotent. Rule: the test must have failed first; a test written after the fix is not a red-to-green story.
